summary: No page of the City of Point Pleasant's own describes the campground: cityofpointpleasant.org shows nothing but a privacy link, pointpleasantwv.org is Main Street Point Pleasant with no campground page, and the WV Tourism listing has a blank Website field. That listing (a state directory, not the operator) repeats the entry's facts: April 1-October 31, 64 full-hookup sites, 14 winter sites, concrete runners, a bathhouse, laundry, phone (304) 675-1068. Nothing changed.
flags: Missing website, and none found: the City of Point Pleasant has no working page for Krodel Park (cityofpointpleasant.org is blank). The nearest thing is the WV Tourism listing https://wvtourism.com/company/krodel-park-campground/ (state tourism directory, website field blank, phone (304) 675-1068, which matches the entry). Rates are known only from aggregators ($25-35, reportedly cash or check, reserve by phone). A town park, so exempt from removal for want of a listing.
